html:
Ambur is a town in northern Tamil Nadu below the passes that lead up from the Carnatic plain to the Mysore plateau. On the 1783 and 1800 maps it names this frontier district.

Its hill fort guarded the road between Mysore and the Carnatic, so armies passed often. At the Battle of Ambur in 1749, Chanda Sahib and French troops killed the Nawab Anwaruddin, opening the second of the Carnatic Wars. In the Anglo-Mysore wars the forts of the area changed hands between Mysore and the British. Today Ambur is known for leather tanning and its biryani.
